kicker: THE CHARISMA TRICK MOST GUYS MISS
title: Make their joke *funnier*

head: When a friend makes a joke
l: Tries to top it with a better one
r: Builds on it, even at his own expense

label: STEP 1
head: Say yes to the joke
sub: Agree with the premise. Don't correct it, don't explain it.

label: STEP 2
head: Then add an and
sub: Push it further with an example where you're the punchline.

items.head: "You make me look tall"
items.sub: Your friend jokes about your height.

items.head: "Yeah, I'm only 4'3"
items.sub: "Stand next to me in every photo. Free 6 inches."

text: His spark becomes fireworks. *He looks funny, you look confident.*
